sv.title: Kina lämnar referensräntor oförändrade
sv.summary: Kinas centralbank, PBOC, lämnar den ettåriga referensräntan LPR (Loan prime rate) oförändrad på 3,00 procent.

en.title: China leaves benchmark interest rates unchanged
en.summary: The People's Bank of China, PBOC, leaves the one-year Loan prime rate LPR unchanged at 3.00 percent.
